name: The Pistachio of the Veneziani Botanical Garden

official_register.name: Regione Puglia, Elenco degli alberi monumentali (Legge 10/2013), CC BY 4.0

access: Municipal botanical garden donated to the Comune di Bisceglie, run by the association Mosquito APS; no general opening hours found. A guided visit was listed for 7 June 2026 at 18:00, free with a donation, booking by phone, groups of 15 to 20. Ask via 327 4216440 or the association's Facebook page.
